parameters.name: AccelerationType
parameters.description:
The acceleration type. Valid values:

*   play: streaming acceleration
*   publish: stream ingest acceleration

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The acceleration channel that you want to reuse. This parameter is required if Reuse is set to yes.

parameters.name: MaxBandwidth
parameters.description: The accelerated bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. This parameter is required if Reuse is set to no.

parameters.name: Reuse
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to reuse an existing acceleration channel. Valid values:

*   yes: reuses an existing acceleration channel.
*   no: creates a new acceleration channel.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream.

parameters.name: VideoCenter
parameters.description: The live center. Valid values: cn-beijing, cn-shanghai, cn-shenzhen, cn-qingdao, ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-5, eu-central-1, and ap-southeast-1, which indicate China (Beijing), China (Shanghai), China (Shenzhen), China (Qingdao), Japan (Tokyo), Indonesia (Jakarta), Germany (Frankfurt), and Singapore, respectively.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-private-line --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name live --stream-name testStream --video-center cn-shanghai --acceleration-type play --acceleration-area ap-southeast-1 --reuse no --max-bandwidth 200 --instance-id ga-bp1iovsdpf01ym9su0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateLivePrivateLine --region cn-hangzhou --VideoCenter 'cn-shanghai' --StreamName testStream --DomainName 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --AccelerationType play --InstanceId 'ga-bp1iovsdpf01ym9su0000' --Reuse no --MaxBandwidth 200 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccelerationArea 'ap-southeast-1' --AppName live
